document.name: HOMIO Frontend Experience Blueprint
document.purpose: Define the canonical frontend product experience for HOMIO as a global real-estate SaaS experience layer over the existing REOS platform.
document.scope: Frontend product experience, interaction model, navigation, responsive behavior, reusable UX, REOS integration, user journey continuity, AI interaction, discovery and decision flows.

authority.frontend_blueprint: This document is the canonical frontend experience blueprint.
authority.project_state: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json remains the canonical execution/project state.
authority.code: Git branch reos-development is the canonical frontend implementation reference.
authority.continuity: ACRL remains the continuity and reconstruction boundary.
authority.chat: Chat is communication only and does not become project state.

non_goals: Do not create a second business architecture.
Do not create frontend-owned business truth.
Do not recreate backend engines in the frontend.
Do not create a frontend duplicate of search, inventory, ownership, deal, commission, fraud, governance, evidence, identity or event engines.
Do not make the frontend mirror backend CORE/T01/T02/T03 structures merely for architectural symmetry.
Do not replace existing REOS capabilities with frontend-local business logic.
Do not make the frontend look like an enterprise backend control panel for normal consumers.

product_thesis.north_star: HOMIO should feel like a premium, simple, intelligent real-estate SaaS product in which the user can discover, explore, understand, compare, save and act without needing to understand the underlying REOS system.
product_thesis.experience_statement: A user should be able to enter HOMIO with a property need expressed in normal language, immediately discover useful opportunities, move naturally from one property to related opportunities, preserve context, receive contextual help, save decisions and continue the journey later.

interaction_reference.principle: Use the interaction philosophy of modern guided SaaS products such as resume builders: simple entry, clear progress, progressive disclosure, low cognitive load, reusable components and the product doing the complex work behind the scenes.
interaction_reference.real_estate_reference: Apply modern real-estate discovery patterns: strong visual inventory, map/context, property detail depth, compare/save/revisit behavior, AI assistance and clear action paths.
interaction_reference.important_boundary: HOMIO must not visually or structurally clone another product. References are interaction lessons only.

product_thesis.frontend_role: The frontend translates existing REOS capabilities into a human-friendly SaaS experience.
product_thesis.backend_role: REOS remains responsible for canonical business truth, domain logic, governance, authorization, transactions, evidence, ownership, financial logic and other platform responsibilities.
product_thesis.success_definition: Users can complete their real-estate task with low friction while remaining oriented, informed and able to continue the journey later.

primary_products.name: Explore
primary_products.user_job: Understand properties, projects, areas and alternatives.
primary_products.primary_question: What is this opportunity really like?

primary_products.name: Decide
primary_products.user_job: Compare, evaluate, save and narrow choices.
primary_products.primary_question: Which options fit what I am looking for?

primary_products.name: Act
primary_products.user_job: Enquire, communicate, schedule a visit, progress a transaction or connect with the relevant professional.

primary_products.name: My HOMIO
primary_products.user_job: Resume, organize and continue the user's real-estate journey.

experience_grammar.principle: Every screen should have one clear primary job while keeping useful secondary paths accessible.

progressive_disclosure.level_4: Advanced actions, professional workflows or transaction detail.

avoid: excessive filters before results are useful
empty decorative sections without user value

exploration_loop.purpose: Allow users to continue exploring useful opportunities without repeatedly returning to the beginning.

context_preservation.behavior: Moving between views must not unnecessarily reset the user's context.

resume_behavior.purpose: A user returning to HOMIO should be able to continue from meaningful previous activity.

consumer_states.frontend_behavior: Maximum useful discovery with minimal friction.
Preserve context and encourage useful exploration.

consumer_states.description: User has an account and persistent journey.
consumer_states.frontend_behavior: Synchronize saved state and resume experience.

consumer_states.description: User is communicating, scheduling or progressing a transaction.
consumer_states.frontend_behavior: Prioritize action clarity and communication context.

consumer_states.description: Agent, brokerage, builder or enterprise user.
consumer_states.frontend_behavior: Expose role-appropriate professional SaaS workspace without changing the consumer product shell.

audience_model.rule: User state changes the experience depth and available actions, not the canonical business truth.

F01.name: HOMIO Experience Foundation
experience_flow: Move through the journey without losing orientation
F01.responsive_behavior: The shell transforms between full desktop navigation, adaptive tablet navigation and mobile-first navigation without removing core actions.
done_when: Any major HOMIO view can be entered and exited without losing context.
Global search is always easy to reach.
Navigation works on desktop, tablet and mobile.
Loading, empty and error states are consistent.

F02.name: Global HOMIO Home & Discovery
F02.user_job: Understand HOMIO and start a property journey immediately.
experience_flow: Choose Homes, Business, Offices or Investments
Enter natural language or simple search intent
screen_anatomy: recent/trending context where supported by data
F02.responsive_behavior: Desktop emphasizes visual discovery; tablet compresses discovery groups; mobile uses single-focus sections and horizontally scrollable discovery rails.
done_when: A first-time user understands what HOMIO is without technical explanation.
A user can begin a useful search within the first interaction.
Returning users can continue prior activity.
No hardcoded business inventory is required.

F03.name: Search Experience
F03.user_job: Find relevant properties without needing to understand a complex filter system.
F03.entry: Global search, homepage search, shared link or saved search.
experience_flow: Enter natural language or structured intent
screen_anatomy: map or location context where useful

filter_strategy.rule: Do not expose every backend search parameter at once.

responsive_behavior.desktop: Rich result layout with optional map/context.
responsive_behavior.mobile: Single-column results with bottom-sheet filters and sticky utility actions.

done_when: Users can get useful results without mastering filters.
Opening a property does not lose search context.
Cards are scannable on all screen sizes.
Search results are powered by existing REOS capabilities.

F04.name: Property Experience
F04.user_job: Understand one property well enough to decide whether it deserves further attention.
F04.entry: Search, saved list, compare, project, shared link or recommendation.

media_behavior.principle: Media should help users understand the property, not act only as decoration.

responsive_behavior.desktop: Immersive media with structured information alongside or below.
responsive_behavior.tablet: Adaptive media plus stacked decision information.
responsive_behavior.mobile: Fast gallery, compact facts, sticky primary actions and bottom-sheet deep details.

done_when: The user understands the property at a glance.
Deep details are available without overwhelming the opening view.
The next useful action is obvious.
Related discovery remains available.

F05.name: Project & Collection Experience
F05.user_job: Understand the larger opportunity around a property.
done_when: The user can move between project and individual property without losing context.
Inventory views reuse canonical REOS data.
Project and property experiences feel like one connected journey.

F06.name: Save, Compare & Return
F06.user_job: Organize choices and reduce decision fatigue.
F06.entry: Search, property, project or My HOMIO.

compare_model.rule: Show only fields that help the user's decision; advanced detail can be expanded.

responsive_behavior.tablet: Scrollable comparison with persistent key labels.
responsive_behavior.mobile: Compact comparison cards with expandable sections.

done_when: Saving is nearly frictionless.
Comparison is understandable without technical knowledge.
Saved items remain available across sessions when signed in.
User can return to the exact decision context.

F07.name: My HOMIO Journey
F07.user_job: Resume and manage the user's real-estate journey.
F07.entry: Profile, saved, notification or return visit.
F07.principle: My HOMIO is a journey resume layer, not a generic account settings page.
done_when: Returning users immediately know what to continue.
The system surfaces meaningful context without unnecessary clutter.
Consumer and professional journeys remain appropriately separated.

F08.name: HOMIO AI & Communication
F08.user_job: Get help in context without leaving the current task.
F08.entry: Search, property, project, compare, saved or journey.
F08.primary_action: Ask or act on contextual assistance.

ai_model.principle: AI is an embedded capability, not a separate product destination.

contexts.search: Help refine the search or explain why results fit.
contexts.property: Explain property facts, highlight relevant details and answer questions using available data.
contexts.compare: Explain differences and trade-offs using available facts without making unsupported claims.
contexts.saved: Help organize and inspect shortlisted options.
contexts.journey: Help identify the next useful action.
contexts.communication: Support user communication using governed workflows.

rules: AI must not become canonical business truth.
AI must not invent property facts.
AI responses must remain grounded in available REOS data/context.
High-risk or irreversible actions remain subject to appropriate backend authorization and human controls.
AI should help the user understand and act, not create unnecessary conversation.
done_when: AI is useful without feeling like a separate chatbot product.
AI context follows the active user task.
Unsupported information is not presented as fact.

F09.name: Enquiry, Visit & Decision Journey
F09.user_job: Move from interest to a real-world next step with minimum friction.
F09.entry: Property, project, saved, compare or AI.
experience_flow: Surface next action in My HOMIO
F09.principle: The frontend simplifies the action; REOS remains responsible for the underlying business workflow.
done_when: Actions are understandable.
User knows what happened after submission.
The resulting journey can be resumed later.

F10.name: Deal Room Experience
F10.user_job: Understand transaction progress and required next actions.
F10.entry: My HOMIO, professional workspace or authorized transaction link.
F10.primary_action: Review progress and complete the next permitted task.
F10.consumer_boundary: Normal users see only appropriate transaction information and actions.
F10.professional_boundary: Professional users receive role-appropriate workflow surfaces without exposing backend implementation details.
done_when: Transaction progress is understandable.
Frontend does not create transaction truth.
Authorization remains server-side.

F11.name: Professional SaaS Workspaces
F11.user_job: Let authorized agents, brokers, builders and enterprise users work efficiently.
F11.principle: Professional workspaces may be denser than consumer surfaces, but must still follow SaaS usability rules.
F11.important_boundary: Professional workspace UI is not the architecture of the backend. It is only a task-oriented presentation layer.
done_when: Role-specific tasks are easy to locate.
Consumer and professional experiences do not become visually confused.
No professional screen invents duplicate business logic.

F12.name: Globalization, SEO & Experience Quality
F12.user_job: Use HOMIO comfortably across countries, devices and languages.
F12.principle: HOMIO is global by design, not India-first with international markets added later.
done_when: Core experiences work across desktop, tablet and mobile.
The experience can adapt to international markets without rebuilding the product.
Public discovery content can be indexed and shared where appropriate.

F13.name: REOS Integration & Production Experience Hardening
F13.user_job: Experience reliable, coherent product behavior powered by the existing REOS platform.
reuse_first_policy: Inspect existing REOS capability before implementing a frontend feature.
Only create frontend transformation logic when presentation requires it.
done_when: Frontend consumes canonical REOS capabilities.
No duplicate business engine has been introduced.
Production errors fail safely and are recoverable.
User-visible states remain coherent across the product.

frontend_architecture_model.architecture_style: Modular application architecture with clear experience boundaries.

layers.name: REOS_ADAPTERS
layers.responsibility: Translation between frontend presentation needs and existing REOS interfaces.

layers.name: FRONTEND_RUNTIME
layers.responsibility: Routing, state, rendering, environment, performance, telemetry and runtime integration.

frontend_architecture_model.rule: Business ownership remains outside the frontend.

implementation_method.name: Experience Slice Delivery
implementation_method.principle: Build coherent user-facing slices rather than backend-style technical layers.
implementation_method.batch_size: Normally 2-3 tightly related files/modules per coherent slice.
implementation_method.implementation_rule: Do not move to the next experience slice until the current slice is visually coherent, connected to the existing product shell and usable on desktop, tablet and mobile.

visual_product_principles.style: Premium, modern, calm, visual and trustworthy.
principles: Property media is central where it helps understanding.
Use motion to explain transitions, not to distract.
Avoid backend-dashboard aesthetics for consumer pages.
Use density only where the user's task requires it.

property_discovery_design.principle: The product should make useful property exploration naturally engaging without manipulative engagement patterns.
property_discovery_design.rule: Every recommendation or related item must provide actual user value and must come from available data or governed recommendation capability.
anti_dark_pattern_rules: No forced account creation merely to browse basic content.

responsive_model.principle: Responsive design is an interaction transformation, not merely a smaller desktop layout.
shared_rules: No functionality should become inaccessible merely because of viewport size.
Critical user context must survive orientation and route changes.
Dense desktop comparison becomes progressive mobile comparison.
Large desktop navigation becomes compact mobile navigation.

reos_capability_bindings.binding_rule: Bind frontend experiences to existing REOS capabilities instead of creating replacement capabilities.

data_truth_boundary.frontend_rule: Frontend display data may be transformed for presentation but must remain traceable to authoritative REOS sources.
data_truth_boundary.derived_data_rule: Derived data can improve experience but cannot silently become canonical business truth.

loading.principle: Preserve layout expectation with skeletons or meaningful placeholders.

empty.principle: Explain what is empty and offer a useful next path.

error.principle: Tell the user what happened and what can be done next.

ai_behavior_model.principle: AI should reduce effort, not create additional work.
bad_ai: pretends to have performed unavailable actions
forces a chat workflow when a simple UI is better
ai_behavior_model.interaction_rule: When a normal control solves the problem faster, use the normal control; use AI where conversational assistance adds meaningful value.

accessibility.principle: Accessibility is part of the product experience, not a final cosmetic pass.

seo_and_public_discovery.boundary: SEO presentation must not create a duplicate business content source.

performance_model.principle: Fast perceived experience is part of product quality.

analytics_and_product_learning.purpose: Understand whether the product helps users without turning analytics into a business-truth source.
principles: Do not use analytics as canonical business state.
Do not optimize for time-on-site through manipulation.
Prefer meaningful engagement over raw screen time.
Show relevant source/evidence context when available.
Differentiate verified information from generated explanation.
Use plain language for user-facing uncertainty.

design_system_model.purpose: Create one coherent visual language across consumer and SaaS surfaces.
design_system_model.rule: Reuse visual primitives broadly while keeping experience-specific composition local to the relevant experience.

prototype_migration.current_problem: The existing frontend prototype is useful as a visual starting point but is a static monolithic page and should not become the production architecture.
replace: remote-only prototype content as production truth
prototype_migration.production_direction: Recompose the existing visual prototype into the experience slices defined by this document and connect those slices to real REOS capabilities.

reuse_first_policy.implementation_rule: Reuse existing code and capability wherever it already satisfies the requirement.
new_code_allowed_when: existing capability needs a frontend adapter
existing primitive cannot represent the required UX

frontend_must_not_do: silently mutate business state outside governed APIs

experience_checks: Can a new user start immediately?
Can a user find useful property results quickly?
Can the user understand a property without information overload?
Can the user naturally continue exploring?
Can the user save and compare?
Can the user return later without losing context?
Can the user ask for contextual help?
Can the user clearly understand what happens after an action?
Does the same journey work across desktop, tablet and mobile?
technical_checks: Loading, empty and error states exist.

experience: Journey has a natural next step.
product: A user can return and continue.

frontend_build_rules.rule_01: Build for user jobs, not backend module symmetry.
frontend_build_rules.rule_02: Reuse existing HOMIO/REOS capabilities before creating new frontend logic.
frontend_build_rules.rule_05: Make property discovery visually strong but information-dense only when useful.
frontend_build_rules.rule_06: Keep search, property, project, compare, save and journey views connected.
frontend_build_rules.rule_07: Treat mobile, tablet and desktop as intentional interaction modes.
frontend_build_rules.rule_09: Do not use manipulative engagement patterns.
frontend_build_rules.rule_10: Keep all high-risk business authority server-side.
frontend_build_rules.rule_11: Prefer a small number of strong reusable components over excessive fragmentation.
frontend_build_rules.rule_12: Do not introduce microfrontends unless a future measured need requires them.
frontend_build_rules.rule_13: Do not convert presentation concerns into business domain logic.
frontend_build_rules.rule_14: The user should always understand where they are and what they can do next.
frontend_build_rules.rule_15: Every experience should support a clean return path.

must_preserve: single source of truth per responsibility
frontend_changes_must_check: Does this change improve a user job?
Does an existing REOS capability already support it?
Does it introduce duplicate business logic?
Does it preserve accessibility and performance?
Does it require a real architecture change or only a UX change?
forbidden_changes: backend terminology becoming consumer UX structure solely for internal symmetry

experience_translation.RETURN: Resume the journey from where the user stopped.

final_product_model.frontend_identity: HOMIO is a global real-estate SaaS experience layer powered by REOS.
final_product_model.key_principle: The complexity belongs behind the product. The user should experience clarity.
